title: The Edible Menu and the Ex-Husband

scenes.title: Surprise at the Registry Office
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov brings Elena to the registry office for a surprise wedding, but she reveals she is still legally married on paper.

scenes.title: Nikita's First Day
scenes.summary: New waiter Nikita serves Eleonora the wrong coffee and gets fired on his first day after refusing to let her talk down to him.

scenes.title: Boasting About the Edible Menu
scenes.summary: To impress her rival hotelier friend Andrey, Eleonora claims her restaurant already has an edible menu and puts Vika on the spot.

scenes.title: The Rich Father's Secret
scenes.summary: Vika covers for Eleonora by promising the edible menu by evening, and Andrey asks Eleonora to look after his son Nikita.

scenes.title: Max's Trick with the Menu
scenes.summary: Vika worries about making an edible menu, and Max uses reverse psychology to get her to let him prepare it for her.

scenes.title: Last Chance and Meeting Gena
scenes.summary: Vika rehires Nikita on Eleonora's orders, while Chef Barinov and Elena meet Elena's bohemian artist husband Gennady.

scenes.title: Quarrel with the Artist Gena
scenes.summary: Elena argues with her ex-husband Gennady, and when Chef Barinov tells Elena not to provoke him, she walks out in anger.

scenes.title: Rice Paper and a Man-to-Man Talk
scenes.summary: Max promises Vika the edible menu will be ready on time and receives rice paper, edible paint, and a food printer from Timur.

scenes.title: Dream of Karelia and Canceling the Menu
scenes.summary: Gennady hints that he wants three hundred thousand rubles for a trip to Karelia, while Eleonora tells Vika to forget about the edible menu.

scenes.title: Portrait of an Ancient Greek God
scenes.summary: Gennady refuses Chef Barinov's money and agrees to a free divorce if he can paint a portrait of the Chef as an ancient Greek god.

scenes.title: Paints for the Chef and Andrey's Visit
scenes.summary: Vika tells Max the edible menu is no longer needed right after he finishes it, and Chef Barinov takes the rice paper and edible paints.

scenes.title: The Guest Demands the Edible Menu
scenes.summary: Nikita refuses to leave work with his father Andrey, who then sits with Eleonora and orders two edible menus from Vika.

scenes.title: An Unexpected Bachelor Party in the Suite
scenes.summary: Senya and Fedya burst into the hotel suite with drinks for a surprise bachelor party and catch Gennady painting Chef Barinov.

scenes.title: Swapping the Paper and Lena's Resentment
scenes.summary: Vika decides to give the one real edible menu to the guest and plain paper to Eleonora, while Elena complains about Chef Barinov.

scenes.title: Calling Lena from the Bachelor Party
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov calls Elena to tell her Gennady agreed to the morning divorce, and Mikhail arrives to complain about the noise but joins the drinks.

scenes.title: Eleonora Chews Plain Paper
scenes.summary: Andrey enjoys his edible rice-paper menu and insists Eleonora try hers, forcing her to eat plain office paper to keep up her bluff.

scenes.title: Katya Stands Up for Nikita
scenes.summary: Eleonora spills coffee on herself and blames Nikita, but Katya defends him and convinces her mother to apologize.

scenes.title: Mikhail's Confession and Toasts
scenes.summary: A tipsy Mikhail confesses to Chef Barinov that he likes Eleonora, and the cooks drink a toast to the Chef's upcoming marriage.

scenes.title: The Eaten Portrait on Rice Paper
scenes.summary: Gennady threatens to display Chef Barinov's portrait in the restaurant, so the Chef tears up the rice-paper painting and the cooks eat it.

scenes.title: A Three-Month Wait at the Registry Office
scenes.summary: Gennady finalizes the divorce and leaves for his flight, and Chef Barinov tells Elena their wedding is scheduled in three months.
